name: ghost
description: GhostMem — a local-first MCP memory server for Claude Code. One binary, one SQLite file, no cloud.

plugins.name: ghost
plugins.description: MCP memory server for Claude Code on macOS and Linux (including WSL): project context injection, memory save/search, and on-demand consolidation. Bundles every macOS and Linux binary behind one zero-config launcher. On native Windows install ghost-windows-amd64 or ghost-windows-arm64 instead. First-run setup is automatic and persistent: it disables Claude Code's built-in file memory, imports memories from projects GhostMem already knows (others import on first use), and writes MEMORY.md redirects in known projects — these changes remain if you uninstall the plugin. The stop-hook save reminder is on by default; the LLM consolidation passes (`reflect`/`resolve`/`supersede`) are opt-in and off by default.

plugins.name: ghost-windows-amd64
plugins.description: MCP memory server for Claude Code on 64-bit native Windows (x64/amd64) — the architecture of most Windows PCs. Bundles a native ghost.exe for the MCP server and both lifecycle hooks; zero configuration. First-run setup is automatic and persistent: it disables Claude Code's built-in file memory, imports memories from projects GhostMem already knows (others import on first use), and writes MEMORY.md redirects in known projects — these changes remain if you uninstall the plugin. The stop-hook save reminder is on by default; the LLM consolidation passes (`reflect`/`resolve`/`supersede`) are opt-in and off by default.
